skillset.skill: 50s CT - 12000% Water DMG (Physical). If user is Water, reduce enemies' DMG resistance by 20% for 10s. If user is Water and when own HP is above 80%, reduce enemies' DMG resistance by 35% instead.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Summer Bazett, increase own DMG by 50% and Skill CT Speed by 30%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
